points.title: 早年生活与金融生涯
points.description: 高更出生于巴黎一个中产阶级家庭，父亲是自由派记者，母亲是秘鲁人。7岁时母亲去世，他随家人前往秘鲁，后返回法国完成学业。1871年，高更成为巴黎一家证券交易所的经纪人，过着富裕的生活。这一时期，他业余时间绘画，受到印象派画家的影响，但尚未决定成为全职艺术家。
points.descriptionEn: Gauguin was born in Paris to a middle-class family; his father was a liberal journalist and his mother was Peruvian. At age 7, his mother died, and he moved to Peru with his family before returning to France to complete his education. In 1871, Gauguin became a stockbroker in Paris, living a comfortable life. During this period, he painted as a hobby, influenced by Impressionist painters, but had not yet decided to become a full-time artist.

points.title: 印象派时期与家庭生活
points.description: 1873年，高更开始与丹麦艺术家梅特-索菲·加德结婚，并育有五个孩子。在金融工作之余，他积极参与印象派画家的活动，与毕沙罗、塞尚等人交往密切。1876年，他的作品首次在印象派展览中展出。1882年股市崩溃后，高更放弃金融事业，决心成为全职画家，但这一决定导致家庭经济困难，妻子带着孩子返回丹麦，高更则留在巴黎追求艺术梦想。
points.descriptionEn: In 1873, Gauguin married Danish artist Mette-Sophie Gad and had five children. Alongside his financial work, he actively participated in activities of Impressionist painters, associating closely with Pissarro, Cézanne, and others. In 1876, his work was first exhibited at an Impressionist exhibition. After the stock market crash of 1882, Gauguin abandoned his financial career to become a full-time painter, but this decision led to financial hardship, causing his wife and children to return to Denmark while Gauguin remained in Paris pursuing his artistic dreams.

points.title: 布列塔尼的原始主义探索
points.description: 1886年，高更首次前往布列塔尼的蓬塔旺，被当地原始的文化和风景所吸引。在这里，他发展出独特的绘画风格，使用大胆的色彩和平坦的色块，摆脱了印象派的光影技巧。他与埃米尔·贝尔纳等艺术家共同探索'综合主义'，强调色彩和形式的象征意义。1888年，高更邀请梵高到阿尔共同创作，但两人性格冲突激烈，最终导致著名的'割耳事件'后分道扬镳。布列塔尼的经历对高更的艺术风格产生了深远影响，使他开始追求更原始、更具象征性的表达方式。
points.descriptionEn: In 1886, Gauguin first traveled to Pont-Aven in Brittany, attracted by the local primitive culture and landscape. There, he developed a unique painting style using bold colors and flat planes, breaking away from Impressionist techniques of light and shadow. He with artists like Émile Bernard explored 'Synthetism,' emphasizing the symbolic meaning of color and form. In 1888, Gauguin invited Van Gogh to Arles to collaborate, but their intense personality conflicts led to the famous 'ear-cutting incident' and their eventual separation. His time in Brittany profoundly influenced Gauguin's artistic style, leading him to pursue more primitive and symbolic forms of expression.

points.title: 塔希提的原始天堂
points.description: 1891年，在画家朋友的资助下，高更首次前往塔希提，寻求原始艺术灵感。他定居在帕皮提，与当地土著女性同居，创作了大量描绘塔希提生活和风景的作品。这一时期，他发展出标志性的风格，使用鲜艳的色彩、简化的形式和象征性的图案。代表作品包括《塔希提的处女》、《游魂》等。1893年，高更返回巴黎举办展览，但反响平平，经济状况依然困难。塔希提的经历成为高更艺术生涯的转折点，他开始探索原始主义、象征主义和神秘主义，创作了许多反映塔希提神话和宗教的作品。
points.descriptionEn: In 1891, with financial support from artist friends, Gauguin first traveled to Tahiti in search of primitive artistic inspiration. He settled in Papeete, lived with indigenous women, and created numerous works depicting Tahitian life and landscapes. During this period, he developed his signature style using vibrant colors, simplified forms, and symbolic patterns. Representative works include 'The Spirit of the Dead Watching' and 'Tahitian Women on the Beach.' In 1893, Gauguin returned to Paris for an exhibition, but received little acclaim and remained financially struggling. His time in Tahiti marked a turning point in his artistic career, as he began exploring primitivism, symbolism, and mysticism, creating many works reflecting Tahitian mythology and religion.

points.title: 重返塔希提与艺术成熟
points.titleEn: Return to Tahiti and Artistic Maturity
points.description: 1895年，高更再次前往塔希提，决心永久定居。他住在偏远地区，生活简朴，但创作力旺盛。这一时期，他的艺术风格更加成熟，作品充满神秘主义色彩和象征意义。他创作了《我们从哪里来？我们是谁？我们到哪里去？》等代表作，探索人类存在的根本问题。然而，健康问题（梅毒）和经济困难持续困扰着他。1897年，高更试图自杀未遂。尽管生活艰难，他仍然坚持创作，完成了自传《诺阿诺阿》，记录他在塔希提的生活和艺术理念。这一时期，高更的艺术成就达到顶峰，对后来的现代艺术产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1895, Gauguin returned to Tahiti, determined to settle permanently. He lived in remote areas, leading a simple but creatively productive life. During this period, his artistic style matured further, with works filled with mystical symbolism and meaning. He created masterpieces like 'Where Do We Come From? What Are We? Where Are We Going?' exploring fundamental questions of human existence. However, health issues (syphilis) and financial difficulties continued to plague him. In 1897, Gauguin attempted suicide but survived. Despite hardships, he persisted in creating, completing his autobiography 'Noa Noa,' documenting his life and artistic philosophy in Tahiti. This period marked the peak of Gauguin's artistic achievements, profoundly influencing later modern art.

points.title: 最后岁月与艺术遗产
points.description: 1901年，高更移居马克萨斯群岛的希瓦欧阿岛，寻求更原始的生活环境。他住在远离文明的地方，继续创作，但健康状况急剧恶化。1902年，他完成大型木雕《神祇的化身》，表达对原始宗教的探索。1903年，高更因心脏病发作去世，年仅54岁。去世前，他仍在创作，完成了《市场》等作品。高更去世后，他的艺术逐渐被重新评价，对野兽派、表现主义等现代艺术流派产生了深远影响。他被视为象征主义和原始主义的先驱，其大胆的色彩运用和对原始文化的探索影响了后来的许多艺术家。高更的一生是艺术与生活融合的典范，他为了艺术理想放弃了世俗生活，成为现代艺术史上的传奇人物。
points.descriptionEn: In 1901, Gauguin moved to Hiva Oa in the Marquesas Islands, seeking a more primitive living environment. He lived far from civilization, continuing to create despite rapidly deteriorating health. In 1902, he completed the large wood carving 'Idols,' expressing his exploration of primitive religion. In 1903, Gauguin died of a heart attack at age 54. Before his death, he was still creating, completing works like 'The Market.' After his death, Gauguin's art was re-evaluated, profoundly influencing later modern art movements like Fauvism and Expressionism. He is regarded as a pioneer of Symbolism and Primitivism, and his bold use of color and exploration of primitive culture influenced many later artists. Gauguin's life exemplifies the fusion of art and life; he abandoned worldly life for artistic ideals, becoming a legendary figure in art history.

supporter.zh: 高更是现代艺术的先驱，他勇敢地抛弃了传统绘画的束缚，开创了象征主义和原始主义的新道路。他的大胆色彩运用和简化形式为后来的野兽派和表现主义铺平了道路。高更追求艺术与生活的统一，为了艺术理想放弃了世俗成功，这种献身精神令人敬佩。他对原始文化的探索和对人类本质的思考，使他的作品超越了时代，成为永恒的艺术瑰宝。
supporter.en: Gauguin is a pioneer of modern art who bravely broke free from traditional painting constraints, opening new paths for Symbolism and Primitivism. His bold use of color and simplified forms paved the way for later Fauvism and Expressionism. Gauguin pursued the unity of art and life, abandoning worldly success for artistic ideals—a spirit worthy of admiration. His exploration of primitive cultures and reflection on human nature transcend time, making his works eternal artistic treasures.

critic.zh: 高更的一生充满了争议和矛盾。他抛弃家庭责任，追求个人艺术理想，被批评为自私和不负责任。他对塔希提土著文化的描绘带有殖民主义视角，将异域文化浪漫化、神秘化，缺乏真正的文化理解。高更的艺术理论常常自相矛盾，他的'原始主义'更多是想象而非真实。此外，他的梅毒问题影响了他的晚年创作，使一些作品充满病态色彩。这些争议使高更成为一个复杂而矛盾的历史人物。
critic.en: Gauguin's life was filled with controversy and contradiction. He abandoned family responsibilities to pursue personal artistic ideals, criticized as selfish and irresponsible. His depictions of Tahitian culture carried colonialist perspectives, romanticizing and exoticizing indigenous cultures without genuine understanding. Gauguin's artistic theories were often self-contradictory; his 'Primitivism' was more imagination than reality. Additionally, his syphilis affected his later work, giving some pieces a morbid quality. These controversies make Gauguin a complex and contradictory historical figure.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，高更被定义为现代艺术转型期的关键人物。他代表了19世纪末艺术家对工业文明和传统艺术的反叛，转向更原始、更主观的表达方式。高更的'为艺术而艺术'理念影响了整个现代艺术的发展。在流行文化中，他常被浪漫化为'反叛艺术家'的象征，与梵高的友谊和冲突成为艺术史上的传奇故事。然而，学术界也越来越关注高更作品中的殖民主义视角和性别问题，对他的评价更加多元和批判性。
objective.en: In academic and popular culture, Gauguin is defined as a key figure in the transition of modern art. He represented late 19th-century artists' rebellion against industrial civilization and traditional art, turning toward more primitive and subjective forms of expression. Gauguin's 'art for art's sake' philosophy influenced the development of modern art. In popular culture, he is often romanticized as a symbol of the 'rebel artist,' with his friendship and conflict with Van Gogh becoming legendary art history stories. However, academia has increasingly focused on the colonialist perspectives and gender issues in his work, leading to more diverse and critical evaluations.

self.zh: 艺术是抽象的，是从自然中提取出来的。
self.en: Art is abstraction; it is drawn from nature and is a kind of distortion of nature.

others.zh: 高更是一位伟大的色彩大师，他的作品充满了原始的力量和神秘的美感。
others.en: Gauguin was a master of color, his works filled with primitive power and mystical beauty.
